cities.name: Sarajevo
cities.local_food_tip: Try ćevapi, burek, Bosnian coffee, homemade stews and traditional Balkan dishes — comfort food with rich flavors and hospitality.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🕌 Walk through the historic old town (Baščaršija), visit old mosques, bazaars and Ottoman‑era streets. → ☕ Coffee and traditional pastry in a local bakery or café.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Visit museums or city landmarks, then stroll along the Miljacka river or pedestrian promenades. → 🍽️ Lunch: ćevapi or local stew with fresh bread and salad.

Sunset: 🌇 Take a short ride or hike to nearby hills for panoramic city + mountain views — enjoy sunset over Sarajevo basin.

Night: 🌃 Explore Sarajevo nightlife: cozy restaurants, live music, relaxed walks through illuminated streets — a blend of history and modern vibe.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoming trees in parks, pleasant weather for walking tours.
🎨 Street‑art, cultural events and open cafés under mild sun.
🚶 Easy walking through old town before summer heat or crowds.
🌙 Evening strolls by the river or through historic streets — warm nights.
🍧 Local ice‑cream, cold drinks and outdoor dining under stars.
🎶 Cultural events or music gatherings in the city centre.
🍂 Leaves changing color around old town and hills — perfect for photos.
🔥 Warm stews and comfort food as weather cools.
🏛️ Museums and indoor cultural spots ideal for rain or chilly days.
❄️ Snow on surrounding hills — nice for winter walks or short hikes.
🔥 Hot drinks, homemade meals, warm ambience in cafés and restaurants.
🏙️ Evening lights over old town — calm, wintery city charm.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Use trams or buses for wider city mobility.
🚶 Center and old town are walkable — best for sightseeing on foot.
🚗 For hills or nearby mountains, taxi or car useful if you want flexibility.
🎟️ Check bus/tram tickets or passes if staying a few days.

city_events.name: Winter Historic Walks & Lights
city_events.description: 🕯️ Evening walks through old town with historic vibe, local music and cozy cafés.

cities.name: Mostar & Herzegovina Region
cities.local_food_tip: Grilled meat, hearty stews, fresh vegetables and Mediterranean‑Balkan style dishes — flavorful and hearty after excursions in nature or old town strolls.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌉 Visit the historic bridge (Old Bridge) and old town — stone alleys, charming architecture and rich history. → ☕ Coffee or breakfast in a traditional café by the river.

Afternoon: 🏞️ Explore nearby rivers, canyons or waterfalls, if season permits — enjoy nature and water beauty. → 🍽️ Lunch: local dishes — grilled meats or fresh produce with salad.

Sunset: 🌇 Riverside walk or canyon overlook for scenic views over water and hills — ideal for photos or relaxation.

Night: 🌙 Quiet evening in old town or small guesthouse — cultural ambience, local music or calm river‑sound nights under stars.

spring.event: Spring in Herzegovina & Old Town Charm
ideas: 🌿 Rivers swell, waterfalls and natural spots lush from spring rains.
🚶 Quiet walking tours before summer rush — perfect for history lovers.
📸 Photo‑friendly light and mild weather around old town and nature.
💦 Swim or boat in rivers / lakes if possible, enjoy cool water after heat.
🌞 Warm Mediterranean‑style days — perfect for relaxed sightseeing and dinners outside.
🎉 Summer festivals or local music on riverside or town squares.
🍂 Autumn colors in hills and river valleys — calm and scenic.
🥘 Hearty regional meals, seafood or local dishes after daytime exploring.

🚶 Old towns and central zones are walkable — good for exploration on foot.

city_events.name: Herzegovina Summer WaterFest
city_events.description: 🌊 River‑side events, small concerts, local food and summer gatherings near water.

cities.name: Jahorina / Olympic Mountains Region
cities.local_food_tip: Mountain dishes — hearty stews, grilled meats, local breads and warm soups — ideal after skiing or mountain hikes.
cities.full_day:
Morning: ⛷️ In winter — ski or snowboarding on slopes; in other seasons — cable‑car up for hikes or scenic views. → 🍲 Lunch in a mountain chalet or lodge.

Afternoon: 🥾 Hike forest trails, explore nearby hills or relax with nature surrounding. → ☕ Coffee or hot drink in lodge with mountain view.

Sunset: 🌇 View from mountain ridges — gorgeous panoramas over valleys, hills and maybe city lights afar if weather allows. 

Night: 🌙 Stay in lodge, enjoy warm food, mountain hospitality, fireplace ambience and calm mountain atmosphere.

🍃 Nature wakes up — green meadows, fresh rivers and early‑season calm.
🔥 Warm meals post‑hike and relaxed evenings in lodge.
🏞️ Cool mountain weather — perfect escape from city/sea heat.

🌌 Starry nights, fresh air and peaceful mountain vibes.
🍁 Golden autumn forests and crisp mountain air — ideal for hikes and photos.
🔥 Hearty mountain meals and warm drinks after shady days.
📷 Beautiful panoramic views under autumn light.

Sunset: 🌇 Riverside bench or cliff view — calm water, soft light and natural serenity. 

Night: 🌙 Stay in small guesthouse near river, enjoy local hospitality — ideal for peaceful sleep after nature day.

Afternoon: 🏯 Visit the Kastel Fortress and old‑town streets, explore local shops and historic corners → 🍽️ Lunch: traditional grilled meat or stew with fresh salad.

Sunset: 🌇 River‑side promenade or a small boat ride on Vrbas — calm water views and city lights.

Night: 🌃 Dinner in local restaurant, maybe a casual night out with youth crowd, live music or relaxed cafés.
